records.jp: うう……。どうしよう……
records.en_original: Ohh... What should I do...?
records.en_auxiliary: Ohh... What should I do...?
records.en: Ugh... What should I do...?

records.jp: あれ……？　まだ悩んでる
records.en_original: What's going on? She's still worried.
records.en_auxiliary: What's going on? She's still worried.
records.en: Huh...? She's still worried.

records.jp: 暴走を止めただけだからね。<CR>悩みを根本から解決したわけじゃないもん
records.en_original: We managed to stop her rampancy, but the root of the problem still remains.
records.en_auxiliary: We managed to stop her rampancy, but the root of the problem is still there.
records.en: We only stopped her rampage.<CR>We haven't solved the root of her problem.

records.jp: 悩み自体は、ちゃんと現実で解決してあげないと
records.en_original: We still need to help her solve her problem here in the real world.
records.en_auxiliary: We still need to help her solve her problem here in the real world.
records.en: We still need to help her solve her problem here in the real world.

records.jp: そ、そうなんだ……
records.en_original: I-I see...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I see...
records.en: I-I see...

records.jp: 大丈夫！　フラグメントを固定化できたってことは、<CR>ヒナちゃんはリンリンの気持ちに共感できたってことだよ
records.en_original: Don't worry! You managed to stabilize the Fragment, which means you were able to empathize with Rin-Rin's feelings.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry! You managed to stabilize the Fragment, which means you were able to empathize with Rin-Rin's feelings.
records.en: Don't worry! If you were able to stabilize the Fragment,<CR>it means you understood Rin-Rin's feelings.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん、早く伝えてあげて
records.en_original: Go on and give her some advice, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: Go on and give her some advice, Hina.
records.en: Go on, Hina-chan. Tell her.

records.jp: んー……
records.en_original: Mmh...
records.en_auxiliary: Mmh...
records.en: Mmh...

records.jp: あの、さ。やっぱり、先輩と会うところから始めるしかないと思う
records.en_original: Er, look. I still think you should start by meeting with him in person.
records.en_auxiliary: Er, look. I still think you should start by meeting with him in person.
records.en: Um... I still think you should start by meeting him in person.

records.jp: どんなに緊張するとしても、直接言葉で伝えるのが、<CR>一番想いが届くんじゃないかって
records.en_original: Regardless of how nerve-wracking it may be, telling him face-to-face will communicate your feelings best, I think.
records.en_auxiliary: Regardless of how nerve-wracking it may be, telling him face-to-face will communicate your feelings best, I think.
records.en: No matter how nervous you are, telling him in person<CR>is probably the best way to get your feelings across to him.

records.jp: でも、まずは踏み出さないと、何も変わらないと思う
records.en_original: But until you take that first step, nothing's going to change.
records.en_auxiliary: But until you take that first step, nothing's going to change.
records.en: But until you take that first step, nothing's going to change.

records.jp: 白井さん……
records.en_original: Shirai...
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai...
records.en: Shirai-san...

records.jp: そうだよ。まずは先輩に話してみなよ！
records.en_original: She's right. You've just gotta talk to him!
records.en_auxiliary: She's right. You just gotta talk to him!
records.en: She's right. You've just gotta talk to him!

records.jp: ユズ……。うん、二人の言うとおりだね。<CR>私、まずは先輩に会いに行くよ
records.en_original: Yeah, I agree with you two. The first step will be telling him in person.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I agree with you two. The first step will be telling him in person.
records.en: Yuzu... Yeah, you're both right.<CR>I'll start by going to see him.

records.jp: そうそう。その意気だよ
records.en_original: I know you can do it! You got this!
records.en_auxiliary: I know you can do it! You got this!
records.en: That's right. That's the spirit.

records.jp: 勇気を出した女の子には、これを進ぜよう
records.en_original: Oh, and here's something for courageous girls like you.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, and here's something for courageous girls like you.
records.en: For the girl who found her courage, I present this!

records.jp: なに？　この指輪
records.en_original: What is this? A ring?
records.en_auxiliary: What is this? A ring?
records.en: What is this? A ring?

records.jp: それ……！
records.en_original: That's...!
records.en_auxiliary: That's...!
records.en: That's...!

records.jp: お守り。つけるといいことあるよ
records.en_original: A good luck charm. It'll help.
records.en_auxiliary: A good luck charm. It'll help.
records.en: A good-luck charm. Wear it, and something good might happen.

records.jp: ライム……。ありがとう！<CR>じゃあ早速メールの文を考えてみる！
records.en_original: Thanks, Lime! Time for me to start thinking of what I'll text him!
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Lime! Time for me to start thinking of what I'll text him!
records.en: Lime... Thank you!<CR>Then I'll start drafting a message right away!

records.jp: それと……！
records.en_original: Oh, and...!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, and...!
records.en: Oh, and...!

records.jp: 何？　白井さん
records.en_original: What is it, Shirai?
records.en_auxiliary: What is it, Shirai?
records.en: What is it, Shirai-san?

records.jp: 私のことは、日菜子でいいから
records.en_original: Call me Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: Call me Hinako.
records.en: You can just call me Hinako.

records.jp: ……ふふっ。わかった。<CR>じゃあね、日菜子
records.en_original: ...Hehe. Okay. See you later, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Hehe. Okay. See you later, Hinako.
records.en: ...Hehe. Okay.<CR>See you, Hinako.

records.jp: 次はなんて送ればいいか悩まなければいいけど
records.en_original: Let's just hope she doesn't start stressing out over the exact text message to send next.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's just hope she doesn't start stressing out over the exact text message to send next.
records.en: Let's hope she doesn't start worrying about what to write next.

records.jp: どうしたの、ヒナちゃん？
records.en_original: What's the matter, Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: What's the matter, Hina?
records.en: What's the matter, Hina-chan?

records.jp: さっきの指輪……。あれって
records.en_original: Was that ring you just gave her...
records.en_auxiliary: Was that ring you just gave her...
records.en: That ring you just gave her... Was it...?

records.jp: そっ。ライムたちがつけてるのと同じものだよ。<CR>さっき固定化してくれたタイミングで作れるようになったの
records.en_original: Yup. The same type we're all wearing. We were able to make it when you stabilized her Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Yep. The same type we're all wearing. We were able to make it when you stabilized her Fragment.
records.en: Yep. It's the same kind of ring Lime and Yuzu are wearing.<CR>Stabilizing her Fragment made it possible to create one.

records.jp: あれをつけることで初めて、リフレクターとのつながりができる
records.en_original: Putting on the ring will connect her to we Reflectors.
records.en_auxiliary: Putting on the ring will connect her to us Reflectors.
records.en: She can only form a connection with us Reflectors once she puts it on.

records.jp: つまり、いくらフラグメントに触れたとしても<CR>固定化できなかったり指輪がなかったりすると力は得られないの
records.en_original: In other words, even with a Fragment in hand, you can't use its power if it's not stabilized or there's no ring.
records.en_auxiliary: In other words, even with a Fragment in hand, you can't use its power if it's not stabilized or there's no ring.
records.en: In other words, even if someone touches a Fragment,<CR>they can't gain its power unless it is stabilized and they have a ring.

records.jp: じゃあ……！
records.en_original: Then...!
records.en_auxiliary: Then...!
records.en: Then...!

records.jp: うん。もう苗ちんには渡してあるよ
records.en_original: Yep. We've already given Sana hers, too.
records.en_auxiliary: Yep. We've already given Sana hers, too.
records.en: Yep. We've already given Nae-chin hers, too.

records.jp: そんな！
records.en_original: What are you thinking!?
records.en_auxiliary: What are you thinking?!
records.en: No way!

records.jp: 心配しないで
records.en_original: There's no need to worry.
records.en_auxiliary: There's no need to worry.
records.en: There's no need to worry.

records.jp: この学校、これくらいのアクセサリーなら全然ＯＫだから
records.en_original: This school lets us wear small jewelry.
records.en_auxiliary: This school lets us wear small jewelry.
records.en: This school allows accessories this small.

records.jp: そうじゃない！　なんで、あの二人も巻き込むの！
records.en_original: That's not my point! Why are you roping those two into this!?
records.en_auxiliary: That's not my point! Why are you roping those two into this!?
records.en: That's not what I mean! Why are you dragging those two into this!?

records.jp: そうしないと原種を倒すことができないから……
records.en_original: Because it's the only way to defeat the Sephirot...
records.en_auxiliary: Because it's the only way to defeat the Sephira...
records.en: Because it's the only way to defeat the Sephira...

records.jp: 早くもっとフラグメントを集めて力をつけないと、<CR>原種を倒せないの！
records.en_original: We can't defeat the Sephirot unless we get stronger fast. And to do that, we need more Fragments.
records.en_auxiliary: We can't defeat the Sephira unless we get stronger fast. And to do that, we need more Fragments.
records.en: We need to collect more Fragments and get stronger fast,<CR>or we won't be able to defeat the Sephira!

records.jp: そしたら世界は……、世界が滅んじゃう……
records.en_original: If we don't...this world is doomed.
records.en_auxiliary: If we don't...this world is doomed.
records.en: Then the world... The world will be destroyed...

records.jp: せ、世界……。嘘でしょ……？
records.en_original: You can't be serious...
records.en_auxiliary: You can't be serious...
records.en: The world...? You're kidding, right...?

records.jp: お願いヒナちゃん！　一緒に戦って！<CR>ユズたちと一緒に世界を守って！
records.en_original: Please, Hina! Fight with us! Help us protect the world!
records.en_auxiliary: Please, Hina! Fight with us! Help us protect the world!
records.en: Please, Hina-chan! Fight with us!<CR>Help Yuzu and Lime protect the world!

records.jp: そんな……。なんで私が……。なんで私なの……？
records.en_original: This is...a lot to take in. And why me?
records.en_auxiliary: This is a lot to take in. And why me?
records.en: No... Why me...? Why does it have to be me...?

records.jp: 戦ってくれたら、報酬だってあるのに？
records.en_original: What if we told you there was a reward?
records.en_auxiliary: What if we told you there was a reward?
records.en: You'll get a reward if you fight, you know?

records.jp: 報酬……？
records.en_original: A reward...?
records.en_auxiliary: A reward...?
records.en: A reward...?

records.jp: うん。リフレクターとして戦って、すべての原種を倒せれば、<CR>たったひとつだけ、なんでも願い事が叶うの
records.en_original: Yes. If you fight as a Reflector and defeat all the Sephirot, any one thing you wish will come true.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. If you fight as a Reflector and defeat all the Sephira, you'll be granted one wish—any wish at all.
records.en: Yes. If you fight as a Reflector and defeat all the Sephira,<CR>you'll be granted one wish--anything at all.

records.jp: 願いが……？
records.en_original: Anything?
records.en_auxiliary: Anything?
records.en: A wish...?

records.jp: そう。『心から願うこと』が……、ひとつだけ叶う
records.en_original: That's right. The one thing you wish from the bottom of your heart will come true.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. The one thing you wish from the bottom of your heart will come true.
records.en: That's right. The one thing you wish from the bottom of your heart will come true.

records.jp: 戦いが終わると、世界は元あったように戻されるんだけど……
records.en_original: When this battle is over, the world will return to to the way it was before...
records.en_auxiliary: When this battle is over, the world will return to the way it was before...
records.en: When the battle is over, the world will be restored to the way it was before...

records.jp: その時、勝者の願いをひとつだけ汲み取って、<CR>望むような変化が起こる
records.en_original: But with one key change: whatever the victor wished for.
records.en_auxiliary: But with one key change: whatever the victor wished for.
records.en: At that moment, the victor's single wish is taken into account,<CR>and the world changes in the way they desire.

records.jp: それって、何でも願いが叶うってことでしょ？
records.en_original: Any wish could be granted.
records.en_auxiliary: Any wish could be granted.
records.en: So that means any wish can come true, right?

records.jp: ヒナちゃんの願いは何？
records.en_original: So what's your wish, Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: So what's your wish, Hina?
records.en: So what's your wish, Hina-chan?

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: やばい！　急いで教室に戻ろう！<CR>次の先生、遅刻に厳しいんだ！
records.en_original: Ohhh, this is bad! We've gotta hurry back to the classroom! Our next teacher gets really mad if you're late!
records.en_auxiliary: Ohhh, this is bad! We've gotta hurry back to the classroom! Our next teacher gets really mad if you're late!
records.en: Oh no! We need to hurry back to class!<CR>Our next teacher is really strict about tardiness!

records.en_original: Wait, really!?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, really?
records.en: Huh...? What?

records.jp: どのみち今日はもう力を使い過ぎてるから活動は無理だし、<CR>この話はまた明日にしましょう
records.en_original: Besides, we used up our strength for today. We've earned a rest. We'll talk more tomorrow.
records.en_auxiliary: Besides, we used up our strength for today. We've earned a rest. We'll talk more tomorrow.
records.en: We've used too much power to do anything else today anyway,<CR>so we'll continue this conversation tomorrow.

records.jp: 願いが……叶う……
records.en_original: My wish could come true...
records.en_auxiliary: My wish could come true...
records.en: My wish could come true...

records.jp: ライム……
records.en_original: Lime...
records.en_auxiliary: Lime...
records.en: Lime...

records.jp: 急がないと、ホントに間に合わなくなる……。<CR>そのために準備してきたんでしょ？
records.en_original: We've got to hurry, or it really will be too late... But we've prepared for this, right?
records.en_auxiliary: We've got to hurry, or it really will be too late... That's why we've been preparing for this, right?
records.en: We have to hurry, or it really will be too late...<CR>That's what we've been preparing for, right?

records.jp: わかってる。だけど……
records.en_original: I know, but...
records.en_auxiliary: I know, but...
records.en: I know, but...

records.jp: 絶対に、守ってみせる……
records.en_original: We'll keep it safe, just watch.
records.en_auxiliary: We'll protect the world, no matter what.
records.en: I'll protect it. No matter what...
